prompt: Each value is your maximum jump length from that index. Can you reach the last index?
why: Track the farthest index reachable so far; if you ever stand past it, you're stuck.
trap: DP works in O(n²), but one farthest-reach pass is enough.

prompt: Remove the fewest intervals so that the rest don't overlap.
why: Sort by end time and keep each interval that starts after the last kept one ends. Earliest end wins.
trap: It's about intervals, but merging isn't the move; choosing by earliest end is.

prompt: Gas stations sit on a circular route. Find the starting station from which you can complete the loop, if any.
why: If total gas ≥ total cost there's an answer; restart just after any point where the tank goes negative.
trap: Trying every start with prefix sums is O(n²).

prompt: Balloons span horizontal ranges. What is the minimum number of vertical arrows to burst them all?
why: Sort by end; shoot at the first end, skip everything it hits, repeat.
trap: Merging overlaps gives the wrong count: a chain of overlaps can still need several arrows.

prompt: Each child needs a cookie at least as big as their greed. Maximize how many children are content.
why: Sort both; give each child the smallest cookie that satisfies them.
trap: No need to try matchings: smallest-fit never hurts.
